title: Pre-render checkers with bar-naming warnings and waivers
context: Common Studio is an open, public-domain music production studio in software, written new in Python with permissive dependencies and released under the Unlicense. This task is part of its first milestones: the licence-clean spine that every later gate depends on. The owner's private reference pipeline may be consulted for ideas only; no text, configuration value, arrangement source, skill or asset from it may be copied, and every name, format and value is authored new.
objective: Implement the pre-render checker stage on the core model and score representation: a harmony-clash detector that blocks, voice-leading, instrument-range and voicing checks that warn, each reporting bar numbers, and a recorded-reason waiver as the only way past a blocker, as Python under src/.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-07: The harmony-clash check returns passed=false and names the bar on a clash fixture and passes on the corrected fixture; parallel fifths and octaves, out-of-range notes per instrument and poor voicing each warn with bar numbers; every check has a positive and a negative fixture.

AC-08: A waiver requires a written reason, is recorded with the arrangement, and is the only way past a blocker; the stage result is machine-readable (stage name, verdict, findings with bar and kind), with tests for a refused blocker, an accepted waiver and the result format.
Tests pass; the commit is DCO signed-off.
output: A pull request adding the checker stage, the fixtures, the waiver record and the machine-readable result format under src/.
